high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "theartofwar_suntzu." The post features a quote from Sun Tzu's "The Art of War," presented in a bold, red and black color scheme. The quote reads: 孫子兵法 STRATEGY WITHOUT TACTICS IS THE SLOWEST ROUTE TO VICTORY. TACTICS WITHOUT STRATEGY IS THE NOISE BEFORE DEFEAT. Below the quote, it states: DAILY QUOTE FROM SUN TZU'S THE ART OF WAR. The post has received 1,903 likes and was shared
